title: Maximum Absolute Sum of Any Subarray
goal: Find the greatest absolute sum of any subarray, allowing the empty subarray.
strategy: Any subarray sum is a difference of two prefix sums. The largest absolute difference is the maximum prefix minus the minimum prefix, including the initial zero.
